topic: Choose a password manager for the family

scenario.topic: Choose a password manager for the family
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when picking a password manager for the whole family?

options.name: 1Password Family Plan
options.upside: Strong security features with offline access and easy sharing
options.tradeoff: Requires learning curve for less tech-savvy family members
options.concern: Some users find the interface too complex for casual use
options.best_for: families prioritizing security and multi-device support

options.name: LastPass Family Subscription
options.upside: Unlimited device support and simple user interface
options.tradeoff: Offline access is limited, requiring internet for full use
options.concern: Recent security incidents have made some users wary
options.best_for: families valuing ease of use and broad device compatibility

options.name: Bitwarden Family Plan
options.upside: Open-source with strong transparency and unlimited devices
options.tradeoff: User interface is less polished compared to competitors
options.concern: Some family members may find setup and troubleshooting harder
options.best_for: families who value transparency and cost-effectiveness

options.name: Dashlane Family Subscription
options.upside: Includes VPN service and easy password health reports
options.tradeoff: Higher cost with fewer devices per user than some competitors
options.concern: VPN feature may be unnecessary and adds complexity
options.best_for: families wanting extra online privacy features bundled in

shared_context: The family has exactly 3 members who will use the password manager
The budget for the password manager subscription is capped at $50 per year
The goal is to find a secure, easy-to-use password manager that supports multiple devices

personas.name: Priya
personas.background: I want a family password manager that offers strong security and extra privacy features like a VPN to protect our online activity.
personas.private_goal: I prefer a solution that bundles online privacy tools with password management for comprehensive protection.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.name: Juno
personas.background: I value transparency and cost-effectiveness, so I prefer an open-source password manager that supports unlimited devices.
personas.private_goal: I want a family plan that is affordable and trustworthy with strong security and flexibility across devices.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

personas.name: Goran
personas.background: I look for ease of use and broad device compatibility so that everyone in the family can access passwords without hassle.
personas.private_goal: I want a simple, reliable password manager that supports unlimited devices and has two-factor authentication.
